# RFC 7541 Appendix C.5 — response sequence without Huffman coding.
# SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE = 256 for this sequence, which forces
# evictions. This is the vector that matters most: it is the only one that
# exercises eviction, so it tests the +32 accounting and the FIFO order
# together. Extracted programmatically from the RFC text (hex dump lines
# concatenated, ASCII sidebar and whitespace stripped) — never transcribed
# by eye.
